India Defends Satellite Policy After Elon Musk's 'Oligarch' Remark

The Indian government has stated that its policies and processes for satellite communication clearances are "non-discriminatory" and "fair." This statement comes after Elon Musk, founder of SpaceX, referred to the Indian government's approach to satellite communication as being influenced by "oligarchs." The government's response aims to counter any perception of bias or unfairness in its regulatory framework for satellite services.
